column1: # Licence texts shipped under licences/ in every release archive.
# scripts/dist_compliance.py reads this file during scripts/package-dist.sh.
#   component  the first cell of a NOTICE.md table row, verbatim; or, with
#              scope "none", a third_party/ path that nothing ships
#   scope      which archive carries the component:
#                          that platform's archive when it bundles a
#                none      not shipped; the text is not copied
#   text       repo path of the upstream licence text; for a toolchain scope
#              the path inside the bundled compiler tree; "lib:<name>" for
#              an AppImage library whose text APPIMAGE_LIB_LICENCE in
#              package-dist.sh stages; "-" when no text is required
#   shipped    file name under licences/; for text "-", the reason no text
#              is required; with scope "none", "-" or the reason the text
#   source     comma-separated repo paths the component is built or copied
#              from; "-" when it comes from outside the repository (a
#              toolchain, a host library, a pip package)
# A component may take several rows, one per text. dist_compliance.py
# refuses a third_party/ directory no row's source covers, a licence file
# (LICENSE*, LICENCE*, COPYING*) under third_party/ that is no row's text,
# a packaging/licences/ text no row names, and a source path that does not
